name: getCompanyPosts
description: Fetches posts from a company's LinkedIn page. Supports pagination via `page` parameter.

name: getPersonDeepProfile
description: Fetches deep profile data of a person from their LinkedIn profile URL.

name: getPersonPosts
description: Fetches posts made by a person using their LinkedIn profile URL. Supports pagination.

name: getPostData
description: Fetches details of a specific LinkedIn post, including article components, text, actor, etc.

name: getPostReactions
description: Fetches users who reacted to a post using its `reactionsUrn`. Supports pagination.

name: getPostComments
description: Fetches comments on a LinkedIn post using `commentsUrn`. Supports pagination.

name: getCompanyProfile
description: Fetches detailed company profile data from a LinkedIn company URL.

name: getSimilarProfiles
description: Fetches similar LinkedIn profiles based on a given profile URL.
